description: Select part of a video clip, then show, hide or fill it: rectangle (rounded), ellipse, linear, mirror, heart, star, polygon or matte (a media's alpha, e.g. a create.cutout), with feather and invert. Several shapes: add. A fill paints the selection from the picture around it and from earlier frames where that area showed, so something that never moves against its background leaves a smudge: nothing ever shows what is behind it. It is a job of its own (job.list shows its progress); a render that needs it names the job until it is done, and an export waits for it. Position, size and rotation animate like transform values. Coordinates are fractions of the clip's fitted frame: a sequence-shaped box with the picture fitted inside (bars where the shapes differ), before the clip's scale and position. A narrower picture fills k = (its aspect / the sequence's) of the box width, centred, so a picture-fraction box maps to x = 0.5 + (x - 0.5) * k, width * k (a wider picture: the same on y and height, with k = the sequence aspect / its). null removes the mask. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).
